description: Retrieve one Docs catalog entry by its id, e.g. card, skill, pricing. Read-only; returns the entry's name, price, notes, and links. Use when you know the exact entry id; use docs_search to find an id by keyword. An unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

id.description: Entry id within the Docs catalog, e.g. card, skill, pricing. Get the id list from docs_search with an empty query; an unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

name: docs_get
